summary: M6_2C_CODER_PLAN (CODER, plan_only). Produced 04-artifacts/impl/M6.2C/PLAN.md: the minimal, staged change set for slice M6.2C (Outbox Workers -- separate runtime requests from external sync via conversion_events -> marketing_measurement_outbox and customer_segments -> marketing_audience_outbox, drained by dispatcher workers with bounded retry/dead-letter and consent re-checked at send). GOVERNANCE (loud): the external-send controls are FORWARD gates, NOT entry blockers, and there is NO M6.2C-scoped fix-first BINDING (M6.2B F1/F2 already closed) -- external_send/production/gateway stay OFF/OFF/BLOCKED; M6-OD-003 (hash policy/permitted send fields) + M6-OD-004 (connector first) are HARD FORWARD gates before M6.2D real send; the M6.2B boundary/security residuals (F-A/F-B/O-1/MINOR-6/MINOR-9-res) are carried forward + deferred to the owner integration step, of which O-1 (no raw PII in outbox payloads) is design-relevant here; the MANDATORY M6.2G Scale-Gate re-gate (ENTRY-001/002/003) stands before any scale/send. STAGING MODEL: carry forward the whole M6.2B tree byte-identical (M6.2C adds a NEW layer, modifies no M6.2B tracking/measurement code) + add the outbox modules; the change set is the DIFF (all new files + 3 additive extensions). SCOPE (in): conversion_events (CTR-007); marketing_measurement_outbox (CTR-008) + measurement dispatcher (CTR-021); customer_segments/members CONSUMED read-only (CTR-009/010, membership NEVER a trigger owner RULE-012); marketing_audience_outbox (CTR-011) + audience dispatcher (CTR-022); POST /api/ads/conversions (CTR-017) creating a conversion + transactionally enqueuing the measurement outbox (fan-out per platform). SCOPE (out): platform-specific dedup/hash (M6.2D); attribution CTR-023 (M6.2E); DQ checker CTR-024 (M6.2F); real send/connector (M6-OD-003/004 + M6.2G re-gate). LOAD-BEARING INVARIANTS the plan centers: (1) RULE-004 no direct external send (exit-gate leg 1) -- the runtime (conversions endpoint + audience enqueue) holds NO Transport and only writes outbox rows; only the dispatcher workers hold a Transport; the staged StagedBlockedTransport REFUSES to send while external_send=OFF, so even the worker makes no real call -- there is structurally no runtime->platform path. (2) RULE-002 two-checkpoint consent (SMK-002, prevents FAIL-002) -- consent referenced at conversion/enqueue time and RE-VALIDATED at dispatch (reuse ConsentGate.permits_send + ConsentReader.current_state); consent-invalid item is NEVER sent (policy-block -> terminal DEAD_LETTER(reason)+audit, no retry loop); member opt-out -> audience REMOVE/not-ADD. (3) Bounded retry -> dead-letter, no silent loss (SMK-016) -- a TRANSPORT failure appends error_log + sets next_retry_at + increments retry_count; retry_count>=max_retries -> DEAD_LETTER; policy-block is a distinct TERMINAL non-send (not an infinite loop); every terminal state carries a full trace. (4) RULE-005 dedup -- measurement dedup_key = platform+event_code+customer_or_guest_key+event_ts_bucket+source_event_id UNIQUE on the outbox row (one per conversion x platform, computed at fan-out); audience dedup_key = segment_id+member_key+platform+operation UNIQUE (distinct from RULE-005). (5) Fail-closed on PII/staged (O-1 carried) -- no raw PII in any outbox row or payload_ref (PII-safe reference only; hashing at dispatch is M6-OD-003/M6.2D); customer_or_guest_key/member_key masked on every export; OFFLINE fan-out only for ORDER_VERIFIED. KEY DESIGN DECISIONS (flagged): (a) Transport abstraction (E1) so RULE-004 + external_send=OFF + testable SMK-016 hold simultaneously (runtime holds no transport, staged transport refuses, tests inject failing/succeeding transports -- none contacts a platform); (b) cumulative staging (carry forward M6.2B); (c) framework-neutral conversions handler (M6-OD-011 framework=''), dispatchers are plain callables run by a test/operator runner (no scheduler dependency); (d) send_policy data_quality_pass is fail-closed at M6.2C (no DQ checker until M6.2F -> items sit at data_quality_status=HOLD -> not pass -> not sent; SMK-016 uses test-seeded pass-policy items + injected transport to exercise the mechanism); (e) policy-block (consent/registry/dq/dedup) -> terminal DEAD_LETTER(reason)+audit, transport-fail -> bounded RETRY -> DEAD_LETTER; (f) revenue_value accepted only for ORDER_VERIFIED (RULE-003; REVENUE_NOT_VERIFIED otherwise; PAYMENT_COMPLETED non-revenue, M6-OD-008). CHANGE SET: models (conversion_event, measurement_outbox, audience_outbox, consumed segments); stores (conversion_event_store, measurement_outbox_store, audience_outbox_store); ports extend +SegmentReader + in-memory segment adapter; outbox seams (transport, enqueue fan-out, measurement_dispatcher CTR-021, audience_dispatcher CTR-022); conversions endpoint (CTR-017); migrations 0003/0004/0005 (staged up+down, never applied; customer_segments/members NOT migrated -- CONSUMED); config extends +OUTBOX_MAX_RETRIES(config value, not owner-mandated; the BOUND is doc-mandated)+platform framework; 6 test files making SMK-002/SMK-016 runnable + no-direct-send + fan-out/dedup + audience chain. Every planned item maps to a done-gate leg (L1 no-direct-send / L2 retry-dead-letter) and/or smoke (SMK-002, SMK-016) with rollback per item (all new files -> delete; 3 extended carried-forward files -> revert to M6.2B); L3/L4 smoke execution handed to TESTER M6-P1203/1204; L5/L6/L7 process/doc. 3 additive extensions to carried-forward files (ports.py +SegmentReader, config.py +outbox constants no-flag-change, migrations/README.md) documented as plan-deltas. Staged, measure-only: global_gateway_state=BLOCKED, production_flag=OFF, external_send=OFF -- no code written, no migration applied, nothing sent/scaled/published, no flag flipped, 04-artifacts/state not touched, no raw secret/PII.
